cases.name: etaf-screensaver-tests-restores-and-releases
cases.purpose: Opening and stopping restores windows, mouse tracking and GC threshold while releasing buffers, timers and processes.

cases.name: etaf-screensaver-tests-key-wakes-without-editing
cases.purpose: A wake key restores the original buffer without replaying or inserting input.

cases.name: etaf-screensaver-tests-pointer-wakes
cases.purpose: Mouse movement, wheel input and completed button-up clicks dismiss presentation while button-down alone is consumed.

cases.name: etaf-screensaver-tests-mode-is-idempotent
cases.purpose: Automatic mode owns a single idle timer, rejects invalid delays and cleans up on disable.

cases.name: etaf-screensaver-tests-external-buffer-kill-cleans-up
cases.purpose: Externally killing the presentation buffer restores windows and stops animation.

cases.name: etaf-screensaver-tests-focus-recheck-keeps-preview
cases.purpose: A global focus recheck without a focus transition leaves a preview alive.

cases.name: etaf-screensaver-tests-playlist-and-order
cases.purpose: Playlist items support inline parameter overrides, reproducible shuffle order and fail-before-takeover validation.

cases.name: etaf-screensaver-tests-timed-cycle-and-transition
cases.purpose: Timer-driven playback reveals page changes smoothly and continues repeated scenes without resetting state.

cases.name: etaf-screensaver-tests-resume-and-preview
cases.purpose: Configured playback resumes after dismissal, explicit previews preserve resume state and config changes invalidate it.

cases.name: etaf-screensaver-tests-card-framing-and-resize
cases.purpose: Card framing draws a thin border and lower-left title on the canvas.

cases.name: etaf-screensaver-tests-canvas-and-colors
cases.purpose: Public canvas drawing handles wide CJK cells, overlap cleanup, alignment, boxes, color mixing and ramps.

cases.name: etaf-screensaver-tests-custom-scene-builders
cases.purpose: Custom scenes work across define-scene, define-text-scene, define-field-scene and define-particle-scene.

cases.name: etaf-screensaver-tests-builtins-and-catalog
cases.purpose: All eight built-in scenes register metadata, render exact viewport geometry and animate autonomously.

cases.name: etaf-screensaver-tests-runtime-error-recovers
cases.purpose: A runtime error inside a scene tears down presentation, restores windows and disables automatic mode.
